description: Wrap external dependencies behind clean interfaces so they can be swapped. Current direct usage: SQLite (storage/database.cr), HTTP::Client (fetcher/), filesystem (favicon_storage.cr), color extraction (color_extractor.cr), crypto/hashing. Architecture doc: 'Wrapper layers - wrap external dependencies instead of using them directly.' Each wrapper should define an interface (module/abstract class) with at least two implementations (real + mock) to prove replaceability.

comments.text:
## Wrapper Interface Assessment

### Current Wrapper Status

| External Dependency | Wrapper | Clean Interface? | Mock Possible? |
|---|---|---|---|
| SQLite | DatabaseService + FeedCache | Partial — exposes DB::Database | Yes (in-memory DB) |
| HTTP fetching | Fetcher shard | Yes — abstract interface | Yes (mock responses) |
| HTTP client (favicons) | FaviconActor | No — HTTP::Client hardcoded | No (needs wrapper) |
| Filesystem | FaviconActor | No — File.* hardcoded | No (needs wrapper) |
| Color extraction | ColorExtractor | No — class methods, no interface | No (needs wrapper) |
| Content storage | Azurite shard | Yes — abstract store | Yes (mock store) |

### Priority Wrappers Needed

1. **HTTP client for favicons** — FaviconActor uses HTTP::Client directly with pooled connections. Needs an HttpClient interface.

2. **Color extraction** — ColorExtractor is used in 3+ places with class methods. Needs an interface with real + mock implementations.

3. **Filesystem** — FaviconActor uses File.* directly. Needs a FileSystem interface.

### Recommendation

Full wrapper implementation is a large refactoring (100+ lines per wrapper). For this epic, focus on:
- Documenting the current state (done above)
- Creating one wrapper as an example (HTTP client)
- Leaving remaining wrappers for a future change

The most impactful wrapper is the HTTP client for favicons — it's the only external network dependency that's directly hardcoded.

title: Add wrapper interfaces for external dependencies
